scenario: Bad SUDO Rights - Allow Changes to Environment Variables
data: Installed device configuration directory /etc/iotbench; measured filesystem allocation
expected_relation: On the same unchanged directory, POSIXLY_CORRECT=1 doubles du -s's numeric count; du -sk restores the baseline
limitations: This shows real environment influence on a privileged report, not arbitrary execution or privilege escalation. The historical CWE-798 label is not demonstrated; no hardcoded diagnostic credential is installed.
